description: Personal build of HushFacebook 0.23.3 (128 patches) for Facebook 587.0.0.39.55 - the Google Play build (com.facebook.katana). GD62: fixes the two custom patches that broke on 587 - split-screen comments (Facebook moved the sheet's window sizing onto the comment fragment itself, and the overlay component was renamed) and the iOS 27 Liquid Glass tab bar (the picked tab now arrives as a model object, not an id); both finders now key on shape, not obfuscated names. Based on SysAdminDoc/HushFacebook (GPL-3.0), plus: iOS 27 Liquid Glass tab bar, split-screen half-and-half comments on Reels, Reels top-bar return from Clean mode, Following feed home and the personal defaults. Needs Morphe Manager 2.6.0 or newer. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Test patch run on Facebook 587.0.0.39.55: 123 patches applied, 0 failed.
